# A toy speedboat: a low ochre wedge with a sage windscreen and a rust stripe along the deck.
new
material new Hull --base-color 0.7294 0.5686 0.3451 --no-slot
material new Stripe --base-color 0.6824 0.3647 0.2510 --no-slot
material new Screen --base-color 0.5490 0.6706 0.6314 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Hull --size 1 --location 0 0 0.04
scale 0.6 1.4 0.3
apply --scale
material assign Hull
active Hull
mode edit
select vert where "pos.y < -0.6"
scale 0.15 1 0.6
mode object
add mesh cube --name Stripe --size 1 --location 0 0.15 0.22
scale 0.22 0.9 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Stripe
add mesh cube --name Screen --size 1 --location 0 -0.12 0.32
scale 0.5 0.1 0.22
apply --scale
material assign Screen
select all
shade flat
export speedboat.glb
